author: DUYTRUYENTHONG
privacy: Aggregate counts only. No candidate or recruiter contacts, employer identities, private URLs, messages, CVs or receipt paths.
count_scope: Unique confirmed submissions or verified email sending under the historically approved original, adjacent and stretch scope. Immediate delivery failures and uncertain attempts are excluded. Sending does not establish employer delivery.
provenance: Maintainer reconciliation of the private canonical ledger and verification of immutable snapshot hashes. Raw evidence remains private; this is not an independent public audit.
measurement_limits: Submission checkpoint only; no new comprehensive inbox review
Do not carry historical response counts or zero-offer observations forward as current
Host-assisted campaign, not an autonomous kit replay
Public snapshots must never populate another user's tracker
